Substitute $x = 69^{0.96}$ and $y = 69^{0.75}$ into $x^z = y^{2}$:

Method 1: Base Substitution & Exponent Equating: Substitute $x = 69^{0.96}$ and $y = 69^{0.75}$ into $x^z = y^{2}$:

Since bases are equal, $0.96z = 1.50 \Rightarrow z = \frac{1.50}{0.96} = 1.5625 \approx \mathbf{1.56}$.

Method 2: Direct Ratio Exponent Formula (`4 sec`): Ratio of exponents $0.75 : 0.96 = 25 : 32$ ⇒ $z = \frac{25 \times 2}{32} = 50/32 \approx \mathbf{1.56}$.

question.en: The income of Raman is ₹61,500. He saves 17% of his income. If his income increases by 38% and expenditure increases by 20%, then his savings will:

solution.approach: Official Answer: Option C (**increase by ₹13,161**).
solution.keyConcept: Direct Change Law: ΔSavings = ΔIncome − ΔExpenditure

optionTrick.en: Notice net $\%$ change in income = $+38\%$, while expenditure change on whole income = $-\frac{83}{100} \times 20\%$. That gives direct Net Factor $= 21.4\%$ of ₹61,500 $= \mathbf{Rs.13,161}$!

trapAlert.en: Never waste 60 seconds calculating New Income and New Expenditure first! Only compute ΔI and ΔE and take ΔS = ΔI − ΔE (positive = increase, negative = decrease).
trapAlert.hi: पुरानी-नई आय अलग से निकालकर 60 सेकंड बर्बाद न करें; सीधे $\Delta\text{बचत} = \Delta\text{आय} - \Delta\text{व्यय}$ सूत्र से चिह्न (+ वृद्धि / − कमी) तय करें।

title.en: Method 1: Basic Income-Expenditure Table
Method 2: Smart ΔS = ΔI − ΔE (12 sec)
title.hi: विधि 2: स्मार्ट Δबचत = Δआय − Δव्यय ट्रिक

solution.en:
Method 1: Basic Income-Expenditure Table: 1) Old Savings $= 17\%$ of ₹61,500 = **₹10,455**; Old Expenditure $= 83\%$ of ₹61,500 = **₹51,045**.
2) New Income ($+38\%$) = **₹84,870**; New Expenditure ($+20\%$) = **₹61,254**.
3) New Savings $= Rs.84,870 - Rs.61,254 = Rs.23,616$.
4) Change $= Rs.23,616 - Rs.10,455 \Rightarrow$ **Increase of ₹13,161**.

Method 2: Smart ΔS = ΔI − ΔE (12 sec): 1) $\Delta I = +38\%$ of ₹61,500 = **+₹23,370**.
2) $E = 83\% \times Rs.61,500 = Rs.51,045$, so $\Delta E = +20\% \times Rs.51,045 = +Rs.10,209$.
3) $\Delta S = Rs.23,370 - Rs.10,209 = +Rs.13,161 \Rightarrow$ **Increase by ₹13,161**.
